title: Rust: A Language for the Next 40 Years - Carol Nichols
summary: Carol Nichols' Philly ETE 2019 talk on what makes Rust unique. It covers memory safety, how editions let the language evolve without breaking code, and who relies on Rust in production.
why: Cited as a talk about Rust's long-term outlook, and as the source of the rail-safety analogy for software safety.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages
